_note: Limited-use features from the authored content layer: the subclasses in src/lib/srd/subclasses.json and the lineages added to src/lib/srd/races.json, as spendable counters. Same row shape as src/lib/classes/resources.json plus `proficiency` (uses = that multiple of the proficiency bonus), `scale` (a descending [level, uses] table) and `byLevel` (a pool sized by character level). Original wording, like the tables themselves. A feature listed here is enforced: use_resource spends it and rests refill it.

resources.guidance: A maneuver that rides a weapon attack (Trip, Disarming, Precision, Menacing, Feinting, Quick Toss, Grappling Strike, Maneuvering and the rest) is named in pc_attack's maneuver: the die goes to the damage or the roll it names, its save DC is 8 + proficiency + Strength or Dexterity, and Feinting Attack and Quick Toss take the bonus action. Parry, Riposte and Brace are reactions: use_reaction. Rally and Commander's Strike are use_resource with variant 'rally' or 'commander's strike' and the ally's targetCharacterId (each takes the bonus action; Commander's Strike also forgoes one attack). A maneuver that rides a check or a move (Ambush, Bait and Switch, Commanding Presence, Evasive Footwork, Tactical Assessment) is a plain spend with that variant.

The shared pool behind every psionic feature of this subclass. Name the use in variant: Telekinetic Movement and Psychic Whispers take an action, Psychic Teleportation a bonus action; Psionic Strike and Psi-Bolstered Knack ride a hit or a check already made; Protective Field is a reaction (use_reaction). Every die returns on a long rest; once per short or long rest a bonus action regains one spent die (use_resource 'Psionic Recovery'). The die size grows with level: d6, then d8 at 5th, d10 at 11th and d12 at 17th.
A bonus action that regains one spent Psionic Energy die, once per short or long rest. Spend it with use_resource 'Psionic Recovery'; the server returns the die.
A bonus action granting advantage on weapon attacks this turn plus temporary hit points: 5 at 3rd level, 10 at 10th, 15 at 15th.
A bonus action for 1 minute: become Large, advantage on Strength checks and saves, and one extra damage die per turn.
A reaction forcing an attacker to reroll a hit against an ally within 60 feet.
One extra melee attack made from the echo's space when taking the Attack action. Resolve it with pc_attack like any other.
When the echo is destroyed by damage, gain 2d6 + Constitution modifier temporary hit points.
A reaction making the echo the target of an attack aimed at another creature.

A reaction when the fighter or a creature they can see within 5 feet is hit, while wielding a melee weapon or a shield: 1d8 on the target's AC against that attack, and resistance to its damage if it still hits. Pass targetCharacterId for another creature; the server re-resolves the hit.

A reaction as damage reduces the samurai to 0 hit points without killing them: they put off falling unconscious and take an extra turn at once. Damage at 0 during it still causes death save failures; when it ends they fall unconscious if still at 0. The server gives the turn.

An arrow's magical rider, chosen from the options known and applied on a hit: Banishing, Beguiling, Bursting, Enfeebling, Grasping, Piercing, Seeking or Shadow. Its save DC is 8 + proficiency + Intelligence.
A reaction imposing disadvantage on one attack roll, against the cleric and, from 6th level, an ally within 30 feet.
A reaction dealing 2d8 lightning or thunder damage to a creature that hit the cleric in melee, halved on a Dexterity save.
A bonus-action weapon attack after taking the Attack action, made with pc_attack (bonusAttack "feature"); the attack spends the use.
An action sensing undead within 60 feet that aren't behind total cover, and where they are.
A reaction turning a critical hit against a creature within 30 feet into an ordinary hit.

Share the cleric's 300-foot darkvision for an hour with willing creatures within 10 feet, as many as their Wisdom modifier (minimum one). Once per long rest, or again by expending a spell slot of any level.
At least a minute of meditation (concentration, up to the cleric's Wisdom score in minutes) reading an object's owners or a place's past events, as far back as the Wisdom score in days.

An action bonding up to the cleric's proficiency bonus of willing creatures within 30 feet for 10 minutes: once a turn each can add a d4 to an attack, check or save while within 30 feet of another bonded creature (60 feet from 17th level).
A bonus action in dim light or darkness granting a flying speed equal to the walking speed for 1 minute.
A pool of d6s equal to the druid's level. As a bonus action spend up to half the druid's level of them on one creature within 120 feet: it regains the total rolled and 1 temporary hit point per die.
A bonus action teleporting the druid 60 feet (variant 'self'), or an action teleporting a willing creature they touch 30 feet (variant 'touch').

An action creates the cannon for an hour (once a long rest; a spell slot buys another). A bonus action activates it: 'Activate Cannon' with variant flamethrower or protector, or the Force Ballista through pc_attack.
A bonus action raising a 30-foot Bear, Hawk or Unicorn spirit aura for 1 minute.

Triggers when the druid drops to 0 hit points or is incapacitated against their will: as conjure animals with a 9th-level slot, four beasts of the druid's choice (each challenge rating 2 or lower) appear within 20 feet, guard them and attack their foes for an hour without concentration.
A reaction reanimating a beast or humanoid that just died within 10 feet as a zombie under the druid's command for an hour.
Free castings of guiding bolt from the map, without a spell slot. Resolve the attack with cast_at_enemy.
A reaction adding a d6 (Weal) or subtracting one (Woe) on an attack, check or save by a creature within 30 feet. The omen is chosen after each long rest and does not change until the next one.
Triggers when the druid drops to 0 hit points while the wildfire spirit is out: the spirit is destroyed and the druid returns at half their hit point maximum.

After a short rest: dream (the druid as messenger), scrying or teleportation circle without a slot or material components; the circle opens to the last place the druid finished a long rest on this plane. Once per long rest.
After a minute of performance, up to the bard's Charisma modifier (minimum one) of humanoids within 60 feet who watched it all are charmed for an hour on a failed Wisdom save.

A bonus action for a minute of majesty (concentration): each turn the bard may cast command as a bonus action with no slot (the cast tools charge it that way while the mantle holds), and a creature charmed by the bard automatically fails its save against that command.
A bonus action for 1 minute: an attacker must pass a Charisma save or lose the attack and be unable to target the bard that turn.
A minute of private conversation frightens a humanoid for an hour on a failed Wisdom save.
A reaction capturing the shadow of a humanoid that died within 30 feet, wearable as their identity for an hour.
A whispered secret charms a creature within 30 feet for 8 hours on a failed Wisdom save, and it obeys reasonable requests.
A reaction copying a successful Bardic Inspiration die onto another creature within 60 feet, without spending an inspiration use.
An action: up to the bard's Charisma modifier (minimum one) of creatures within 60 feet understand the bard for an hour. A spell slot buys another use.
An action creating a nonmagical item worth up to 20 times the bard's level. A spell slot buys extra uses.

An action animating a Large or smaller nonmagical item within 30 feet as a Dancing Item for an hour: AC 16, 10 + five times the bard level hit points, a Force-Empowered Slam of 1d10 + proficiency force with the bard's spell attack. Once per long rest; a spell slot of 3rd level or higher buys another use.

An hour-long ritual during a rest with up to the bard's proficiency bonus in willing creatures: the bard learns one divination or necromancy spell from any list, of a level they can cast and no higher than the number of participants, until they start a long rest.
A bonus action granting up to ten allies within 60 feet advantage on attacks and saves until the barbarian's next turn.
A free casting of augury or clairvoyance using Wisdom, with no slot or components.
An action sensing spells and magic items within 60 feet that aren't behind total cover, and the school of each spell.

Touch a creature: for 10 minutes it adds a d3 to attack rolls and ability checks, or it rolls a d3 and regains one expended spell slot of that level or lower (each creature takes the slot only once per long rest).
A natural-weapon hit forces a Wisdom save: the target either attacks a creature of the barbarian's choice or takes 2d12 psychic damage.

Part of entering a rage, with no action of its own: up to the barbarian's Constitution modifier (minimum one) of willing creatures within 30 feet each add a d6 to the damage of one hit on each of their turns until the rage ends, and the barbarian gains 5 temporary hit points per creature that accepts.

A bonus action cursing a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute (use_resource with targetEnemyId): the warlock adds their proficiency bonus to damage against it and scores a critical hit against it on a 19 or 20, and regains warlock level + Charisma modifier hit points when it dies. The server applies the damage, the critical range and the healing.
An action charming or frightening every creature in a 10-foot cube that fails a Wisdom save, until the end of the warlock's next turn.
A reaction on taking damage that turns the warlock invisible and teleports them 60 feet.

An action: a creature within 60 feet is charmed or frightened (the warlock's choice) for a minute on a failed Wisdom save, lost in an illusory misty realm; it ends if the warlock's concentration breaks or the creature takes damage.
A reaction imposing disadvantage on an attack; if it then misses, the warlock has advantage on their next attack against that creature.
A pool of d6s equal to 1 + the warlock's level. Spend up to their Charisma modifier of them as a bonus action to heal a creature within 60 feet.
Instead of rolling a death save, rise at half hit points, blinding enemies within 30 feet and dealing 2d8 + Charisma radiant damage to them.
A humanoid the warlock kills rises as an obedient specter with extra temporary hit points until the next long rest.

A bonus action summoning a 10-foot spectral tentacle for 1 minute: a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of it for 1d8 cold damage (2d8 from 10th level), and the target's speed drops by 10 feet until the start of the warlock's next turn.
Evard's black tentacles once without a spell slot; casting it gives temporary hit points equal to the warlock level and damage can't break the concentration on it.
Teleport the warlock and up to five willing creatures to a body of water within a mile.
A bonus action for 1 minute: 1d10 + warlock level temporary hit points, immunity to being frightened, and one creature hit each turn is frightened on a failed Wisdom save.

A reaction as damage reduces the warlock to 0 hit points: they drop to 1 hit point instead, each enemy within 30 feet takes 2d10 + the warlock level in necrotic damage, and they gain a level of exhaustion. It returns after 1d4 long rests. The server applies all of it.

An action projecting the warlock's spirit for up to an hour (concentration): resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, a flying speed equal to the walking speed, movement through creatures and objects, and in Form of Dread, once a turn, hit points back equal to half the necrotic damage they deal.
Regain 1d8 + Constitution modifier hit points on succeeding at a death save or stabilizing a creature.
A bonus action healing 1d8 + warlock level and reattaching severed body parts.

Bottled Respite: as an action the warlock vanishes into the vessel for up to twice their proficiency bonus in hours, leaving early as a bonus action. From 10th level up to five willing creatures within 30 feet come too; staying 10 minutes gives them a short rest's benefits, and Hit Dice spent inside add the warlock's proficiency bonus.

The effect of one spell of 6th level or lower with a casting time of one action, from any class's list, ignoring requirements and costly components. It returns only after 1d4 long rests; the server keeps the count.
Advantage on one attack, ability check or saving throw. The DM may trigger a Wild Magic Surge afterwards to restore the use.
Add 2d4 to a failed saving throw or a missed attack, possibly turning it into a success.
A bonus action when the sorcerer has fewer than half of their hit points left, restoring hit points equal to half their maximum. The server heals them.

When damage drops the sorcerer to 0 hit points: a Charisma save (DC 5 + the damage) leaves them at 1 instead. It does not work against radiant damage or a critical hit, and only a success spends the use.
A reaction cancelling advantage or disadvantage on a roll by a creature within 60 feet.
A minute during which attacks against the sorcerer cannot have advantage and any d20 of 9 or lower counts as a 10 on their attacks, checks and saves.
A 30-foot cube healing 100 hit points among creatures in it, ending spells of 6th level or lower and repairing objects.
Teleport 120 feet, pulling creatures toward the vacated space for 3d10 force damage on a failed Strength save.

A bonus action releasing the current phase: Full Moon blinds creatures of the sorcerer's choice within 30 feet on a failed Constitution save and heals one of them 3d8; New Moon deals 3d10 necrotic and speed 0 on a failed Dexterity save and turns the sorcerer invisible; Crescent Moon teleports them and one willing creature 60 feet with resistance to all damage until their next turn. Again for 5 sorcery points.
The current phase's 1st-level spell, cast once without a spell slot until the next long rest.
Metamagic on a spell of the current phase's schools costs 1 sorcery point less (minimum 0).
One 1st-level spell of each phase cast once without a spell slot; changing the phase costs 1 sorcery point and a bonus action.
Rolled after each long rest and kept as fixed numbers. Spend one to replace the result of an attack, check or save by the wizard or a creature they can see, declared before the roll.
A reaction interposing an illusory duplicate so an attack that would hit misses instead.
Teleport 30 feet or swap places with a willing creature. Also recharges whenever the wizard casts a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.
A free self-polymorph into a beast of challenge rating 1 or lower, without a spell slot.
An action granting one until the wizard is incapacitated or rests: darkvision 60 feet, ethereal sight 60 feet, reading any language, or seeing invisible creatures and objects within 10 feet.

Once per turn when a wizard spell damages a creature or object: extra force damage equal to half the wizard level. The wizard starts each day with one surge, gains one by ending a spell with dispel magic or counterspell, and one after a short rest with none; they hold up to their Intelligence modifier.

A bonus action for 1 minute: add the Intelligence modifier to AC, 10 feet of speed, advantage on Acrobatics, and a bonus on concentration saves. It ends if the wizard wears medium or heavy armor or a shield, or is incapacitated.
A reaction forcing a creature within 30 feet to reroll an attack, check or save after the wizard sees whether it succeeded; the second roll stands.
A Large or smaller creature within 60 feet is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of the wizard's next turn, or until it takes damage, on a failed Constitution save.
Store a spell of 4th level or lower in a bead that any creature can break to cast it, using the wizard's spellcasting numbers.
A reaction adding 1d10 to a weapon attack's damage by a creature within 60 feet, or 2d10 to a creature's falling damage.

A minute (concentration) of crushing gravity in 30 feet: a hostile creature starting its turn there takes 2d10 force and has speed 0 on a failed Strength save, half damage and costly movement on a success. A spell slot of 3rd level or higher buys extra uses.

A bonus action manifesting the spellbook's mind within 60 feet (it ends beyond 300 feet), so the wizard can cast from its space. Free once per long rest; a spell slot of any level buys another manifestation.
A wizard spell cast from the manifested mind's space: a proficiency-bonus number a day. Spend one with use_resource 'Manifest Mind casting' as the spell is cast.
After a long rest, a scroll of a 1st- or 2nd-level wizard spell from the book with a casting time of an action; it is cast as one level higher and vanishes once cast or at the next long rest.

A reaction to damage while the Manifest Mind is summoned: all of that damage is prevented and the mind is dismissed; spells totalling 3d6 levels or more vanish from the spellbook until 1d6 long rests pass. The server prevents the damage and rolls the 3d6.
An action revealing a creature's damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities, or that it has none.
A reaction forcing a caster or teleporter within 60 feet to make a Wisdom save or lose the spell and the action.
A bonus-action etherealness lasting a single turn.
Sense the distance and direction to the closest planar portal within a mile.
A bonus action granting a 10-foot flying speed for 1 minute, carried by the swarm.
A reaction to damage just taken: resistance to that damage, and the ranger teleports up to 30 feet. The server gives back the resisted half.
A free misty step that can bring one willing creature within 5 feet along.
A free casting of summon fey without a spell slot or material component, once per long rest; it can be cast without concentration, lasting a minute.

Summon the drake for as long as it lasts: it acts on the ranger's initiative, has 5 + five times the ranger level hit points, bites for 1d6 + proficiency piercing, and is immune to its chosen essence. A spell slot of 1st level or higher buys another summoning.
The ranger or the drake exhales a 30-foot cone of acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison: 8d6 (10d6 from 15th level), halved on a Dexterity save. A spell slot of 3rd level or higher buys extra uses.
A reaction when the ranger or their drake takes damage within 30 feet of each other: the one hurt resists that damage. The server gives back the resisted half (use_reaction 'Reflexive Resistance').
After a sneak attack, a second creature within 30 feet takes half the sneak attack dice in necrotic damage.
A bonus action granting 10 minutes of spectral form: a 10-foot fly speed and movement through creatures and objects. A soul trinket buys extra uses.
An hour of invisibility, ending early if the rogue deals damage or forces a saving throw. A Psionic Energy die buys extra uses.
A sneak attack with Psychic Blades stuns a creature for 1 minute on a failed Wisdom save. Three Psionic Energy dice buy extra uses.

A reaction after a spell targets the rogue or catches them: the caster saves with its spellcasting ability against the rogue's spell save DC, and on a failure the spell has no effect on them, and if they can cast its level the rogue knows it for 8 hours and the caster cannot cast it.
An action sensing illusions, shapechangers and other magical deception within 30 feet, without learning what is hidden.
Reroll a missed attack, with advantage.
Spend 5 ki to return a creature dead no more than 24 hours to life with 4d10 + Wisdom hit points, free of every condition it died with.

Replace one Attack-action attack with a 20-foot cone or 30-foot line of the monk's chosen damage type: two rolls of the martial arts die (three from 11th level), halved on a Dexterity save. With no use left, 2 ki buys another (the server spends them).
When the monk uses Step of the Wind: a flying speed equal to the walking speed until the end of the turn.
A bonus action raising a 10-foot aura for 1 minute that either frightens enemies or grants allies resistance to the monk's damage type. Three ki buys extra uses.
A reaction adding the paladin's Charisma modifier to the AC of themselves or an ally within 10 feet; if the attack then misses, they may attack the attacker.
Triggers on its own: drop to 1 hit point instead of 0.
A reaction to damage just taken: 1d12 + the goliath's Constitution modifier comes off it. The server rolls it and gives the hit points back.
An action: a touched creature regains hit points equal to a number of d4s equal to the aasimar's proficiency bonus (MotM). Once a long rest.

A bonus action from 3rd level for a minute of transformation (MotM): pass variant heavenly wings (a flying speed equal to the walking speed), inner radiance (bright light; each creature within 10 feet takes radiant damage equal to the proficiency bonus at the end of each of the aasimar's turns) or necrotic shroud (creatures within 10 feet make a Charisma save or are frightened until the end of the aasimar's next turn). Once on each turn, one target of the aasimar's attack or spell takes extra damage equal to the proficiency bonus: radiant, or necrotic for the shroud (apply_damage).
A bonus action turning the firbolg invisible until the start of their next turn, or until they attack, cast or force a save.
A free casting of detect magic or disguise self, using Wisdom, without a slot. Disguise self can change the firbolg's size between Medium and Small.
Extra damage equal to the goblin's level on a hit against a creature larger than them.

A bonus-action bite, made with pc_attack (weapon "bite", bonusAttack "feature"): on a hit the lizardfolk also gains temporary hit points equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1). The attack spends the use.

The genasi's inherited spell, cast without a slot: burning hands, create or destroy water, levitate or pass without trace depending on their element. The matching cantrip is at will and does not use this counter.
A reaction adding the artificer's Intelligence modifier to an ability check or saving throw by them or an ally within 30 feet.

resources.displayName: The Right Tool for the Job
match: the right tool for the job
resources.guidance: An hour with tinker's tools conjures any set of artisan's tools needed, lasting until the next use.

Elixirs brewed on a long rest (one, two from 6th level, three from 15th), each rolled on a d6: healing (2d4 + Intelligence), swiftness (+10 feet of speed for an hour), resilience (+1 AC for 10 minutes), boldness (a d4 on attacks and saves for a minute), flight (a 10-foot flying speed for 10 minutes) or transformation (alter self). A spell slot brews another of a chosen effect. From 9th level a drinker also gains 2d6 + Intelligence temporary hit points.
An action builds a flamethrower, force ballista or protector cannon, and a bonus action activates it. A spell slot buys extra uses.
After a long rest, store a 1st or 2nd-level artificer spell in an item; the holder can cast it twice the artificer's Intelligence modifier in times.
Once per turn, a magic-weapon or Steel Defender hit deals an extra 2d6 force damage, or heals a creature within 30 feet of the target 2d6. Rises to 4d6 at 15th level.
Free castings of lesser restoration without a spell slot, with alchemist's supplies as the focus.

A bonus action spends one Wild Shape use to take a starry form for 10 minutes: Archer (a bonus-action luminous arrow, resolved by the server), Chalice (healing spells also heal a second creature 1d8 + WIS), or Dragon (concentration saves treat a low d20 as a 10). Pass variant to choose; the constellation's mechanics apply automatically. This counter mirrors Wild Shape uses.

Casting an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher as a bonus action instead of an action. Spend it with use_resource on their turn; the next such spell they cast this turn then takes the bonus action.

A reaction when a creature dies near the druid or the Wildfire Spirit: the flame heals an ally (variant 'heal', targetCharacterId) or burns an enemy (variant 'burn', targetEnemyId) for 2d10 + WIS. The server rolls and applies it.

The bonus-action melee attack against a marked creature that damaged someone else, on the fighter's next turn: pc_attack bonusAttack "feature" at that creature, with advantage and +half the fighter level damage; the attack spends the use. The mark itself the server lays on every melee hit.

A bonus action: the psi warrior and up to INT-modifier allies within 30 feet gain half cover (+2 AC, +2 DEX saves) for a minute. Once per long rest, or by spending a Psionic Energy die. The server applies it.
Telekinesis once without a slot; while concentrating on it, a weapon attack as a bonus action (pc_attack bonusAttack 'feature').
An action: for a minute, 10 hit points at the start of each turn and enemies within 10 feet save at disadvantage against the paladin's spells. The server applies both.
An action: for an hour, a 60-foot flying speed; enemies within 30 feet save (WIS) or are frightened, and attacks against the frightened have advantage. The server rolls the saves.
An action: resistance to all damage for a minute (the server applies it); the extra attack and the 19-20 critical are narrated.

A bonus action: for a minute, advantage on Charisma checks (the server applies it), once on each turn a missed weapon attack can hit instead, and a failed save can be rerolled with the reaction. A 5th-level spell slot buys another use.
A bonus action: truesight 120 feet and advantage on attacks against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey and fiends for a minute. The server applies the advantage.
An action: for an hour, resistance to nonmagical weapon damage and advantage on Wisdom saves. The server applies both to the paladin.

An action: for a minute, a 30-foot aura of gloom; each enemy frightened of the oathbreaker that starts its turn in it takes 4d10 psychic, sight-reliant attackers have disadvantage against them, and a bonus action makes a melee spell attack with the shadows for 3d10 + Charisma necrotic (pc_attack weapon "Dread Lord's Shadows"). The server applies all of it.
An action: the sorcerer and up to 3 + CHA-modifier creatures within 30 feet gain a flying speed for an hour. The server marks them flying.

A bonus action: a 30-foot flying speed for 10 minutes (use_resource 'Elemental Flight'). The resistance is to the patron's damage type, chosen with Genie's Vessel (use_resource 'Genie's Vessel' with the patron's kind as the variant).
A bonus action in Guardian armor: temporary hit points equal to the artificer level (use_resource 'Defensive Field').

A reaction in Guardian armor when a Huge or smaller creature ends its turn within 30 feet: it saves on Strength or is pulled up to 25 feet toward the armorer, who may then attack it if it lands within 5 feet. The server rolls the save (use_reaction 'Perfected Armor').

The ward's hit points: twice the wizard level plus the Intelligence modifier. The first abjuration spell of 1st level or higher after a long rest raises it at full strength, damage to the wizard lands on it first, and each later abjuration spell restores twice its level. The server keeps it; nobody spends it by hand.
Whether the Arcane Ward has been raised since the last long rest (it is raised once a day, by the first abjuration spell of 1st level or higher). The server keeps it.
